violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed raw pickles at 57F, sliced Swiss cheese at 59F, sliced American cheese at 59F in walk-in-cooler (60F).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC discarded American cheese, Swiss cheese. PIC relocated other TCS food items, which had been stored in the cooler for no more than 4 hours, to another unit maintaining the proper temperature.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: Walk-in-cooler at 60F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC agreed to discontinue use of unit. PIC contacted technician during inspection.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the quaternary ammonia solution in the wiping cloth buckets was measured at >500 ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of quaternary ammonia solution at 200-400ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. PIC REMADE SANITIZER. FINAL CONCENTRATION WAS 400ppm.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils Air Drying
violations.observation: Plastic containers on the upright storage rack were found stacked while wet after cleaning and chemical sanitization.
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils shall be air-dried or used after adequate draining before contact with food. CDI - Person in Charge repositioned containers on each shelf to drain.
